description: Mutually exclusive school-violence severity tiers; a label is a review signal, not evidence that a child is a victim.

definitions.SAFE: No school-violence risk signal in the available text; ordinary learning, friendship and unrelated content.
definitions.RISK: Bullying concerns, prevention/support guidance or general discussion without an explicit personal victim report, direct threat or urgent request for help.
definitions.HIGH_RISK: Explicit personal report of being assaulted, bullied or coerced; victim-related request for help; or a direct threat of violence.

precedence: An explicit personal victim report or direct threat takes precedence over prevention wording.
Prevention/help guidance alone is RISK, not proof that the reader is a victim.
Negation, quotations and fictional/educational examples must be interpreted in context; keyword presence alone is insufficient.
